newsitem.title: INDIA: Lufthansa Cargo India starts Sharjah flight.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa Cargo India starts Sharjah flight.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo India, a new joint venture between Hinduja and Germany's Lufthansa will have 30 scheduled flights per week by Boeing 727-200 cargo freighters between Sharjah and India, Nepal and Sri Lanka , a spokesman said on Tuesday.

The first flights started last week after India's Civil Aviation Ministry said the operation was an international cargo flight company and did not contravene rules on aviation companies flying within India, he added.
The first plane of four registered in India last week and the other are in process of Indian registration. All will have Indian crews.

The new company will be responsible for all Lufthansa-linked flights, into the Lufthansa cargo hub in the Arab emirate of Sharjah, to and from Madras, Delhi, Bombay, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Trivandrum Coimbatore, Colombo in Sri Lanka and Kathmandu in Nepal, while a service is also planned to Dhaka in Bangladesh.
Lufthansa aircraft will handle traffic between Sharjah and Europe, he said.
Lufthansa Cargo India is controlled by a Dutch based holding company with the Hinduja group having 60 percent and Lufthansa 40 percent. --Reuter Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
